hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom AMM hook that routes swap liquidity through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault and output tokens are withdrawn from another, allowing LP capital to simultaneously earn lending yield. Direct concentrated liquidity provision is blocked (beforeAddLiquidity reverts), and all liquidity is backed exclusively by Euler vault positions.
